card.name: Partway through chemical and drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through chemical or drug names, just before the next part of the name or a listed ingredient. Typical spots are the end of 'excipients', the 'one' in 'Betamethasone', and punctuation inside a chemical name.

modes.label: Punctuation inside chemical names
modes.description: A hyphen or bracket inside a long chemical or gene-product name before the name continues.
